homeFaq.heading: Frequently asked questions
homeFaq.a1: Yollla is a mobile-first job marketplace for Uzbekistan. Every posting shows salary, schedule, and contract type up front, and applications go through in two taps. The focus is blue-collar and mass-hiring roles.
homeFaq.q2: Do I need to sign up to search for jobs?
homeFaq.a2: No. As a guest you can browse listings, apply filters, and even start filling in an application. Sign-in is only requested at the final click, and anything you typed is restored afterwards.
homeFaq.a3: On any job page, tap "Apply — 2 clicks". If you already have a résumé it goes straight to the employer; if not, you'll create a short one first. Employers usually reply within a few days.
homeFaq.a4: Tashkent, Samarkand, Andijan, Fergana, Namangan, Bukhara, Khorezm, and other regional capitals. The full list is on the home page under "By city" and on the map view.
homeFaq.a5: Every listing shows the salary in Uzbek som ("2 500 000 – 4 000 000 so'm") with a gross / net tag. Where an employer chose "negotiable", the number is discussed at the interview.
homeFaq.q6: How do I create a résumé?
homeFaq.a6: Use "Create résumé" — a step-by-step form covering personal details, experience, education, and contacts. An AI assistant can draft the "About me" section. The résumé is saved and attached to every application.
homeFaq.q7: Is Yollla free for job seekers?
homeFaq.a7: Yes — search, applications, saved searches, and messaging are all free for seekers. Employers also get their first vacancy free; further listings pick a per-listing tier (Standard / Brand / Premium).

landingFaq.heading: About {category} jobs
landingFaq.q1: How do I find the best {category} openings?
landingFaq.a1: The list on this page is the current set of open {category} vacancies. Each card shows salary, schedule, and contract type — pick one and use "Apply — 2 clicks".
landingFaq.q2: What's the average salary for a {category}?
landingFaq.a2: Pay varies by experience, city, and employer. See the exact numbers on each posting above — every card carries a real range.
landingFaq.q3: Can I get a {category} job without prior experience?
landingFaq.a3: Yes — many postings are open to "no experience" and entry-level candidates. Filter by "Experience: none" or "Entry" to see only those.
landingFaq.a4: Scroll to the "By city" block below to open the city-specific list — Tashkent, Samarkand, Andijan and others.
landingFaq.q5: What documents do I need for a {category} job?
landingFaq.a5: Usually a passport copy plus, where relevant, a diploma or certificate. Some roles need a medical clearance or a driver's licence — that's listed under "Requirements" on the posting.
landingFaq.q6: What's the difference between an official contract and a GPH?
landingFaq.a6: An official contract is a full labour-code employment agreement (tax, leave, social insurance). GPH is a civil-law contract, simpler and good for one-off work. Every posting shows which type it is.
landingFaq.a7: Every day. New postings appear on this page the moment an employer publishes them — no manual moderation. Subscribe via "Saved searches" to catch new ones early.

regionPage.metaDescription: Open vacancies in {region}: pay, schedule and employer details on every listing. Apply without signing up first — Yollla.
regionPage.intro: Every open vacancy in {region}, in one place. Pick an industry or browse the newest postings — pay and schedule are on the card, and applying takes two taps.

regionFaq.heading: Working in {region} — questions and answers
regionFaq.q1: How do I find a job in {region}?
regionFaq.a1: Pick an industry from the cards above: each one shows how many vacancies are open in this region right now. Opening a card narrows the list to that industry in this region only.
regionFaq.q2: Do I need an account to apply?
regionFaq.a2: No. Browsing vacancies and filling in the application form works without one — you are asked to sign in only at the final step, and nothing you typed is lost.
regionFaq.q3: Which industry has the most vacancies in {region}?
regionFaq.a3: The cards on this page are ordered by open vacancies, so the top one is where this region is hiring hardest today. The numbers are live and move as employers post.
regionFaq.a4: The list updates as employers publish, and expired postings drop out on their own. The newest ones are collected in the "newest vacancies" block on this page.
regionFaq.a5: Yes — Yollla requires pay on every posting, either an exact figure or a range. The schedule, formal-employment status and extra conditions are on the card too.

employerLanding.metaTitle: For employers — post a vacancy for free
employerLanding.metaDescription: Post a vacancy for free: it goes live on the site and in the Telegram channel for your trade and region, and matching candidates are surfaced automatically.
employerLanding.heroSub: Post once: the vacancy goes live on the site and in the Telegram channel for your trade and your region. Matching candidates from the résumé pool are surfaced for you automatically.
employerLanding.methodsTitle: How you will fill the role
employerLanding.m1Body: The listing shows up immediately on the site, on its trade and region pages and on the map. At the same time it is posted to our Telegram channel for that trade and region — no extra work, no extra fee.
employerLanding.m2Body: As soon as you publish, the platform picks matching people out of the résumé pool by title, experience and region. Invite the ones you like in one tap.
employerLanding.m3Title: In a hurry? Move to the front
employerLanding.m3Body: TOP and bump put your listing at the head of the list. You pay only for the period you choose, from your wallet.
employerLanding.channelsTitle: Your vacancy reaches channel subscribers too
employerLanding.channelsBody: Listings are published to our channels by trade and region — the candidates are already there.
employerLanding.ctaTitle: Post today, talk to candidates tomorrow
employerLanding.ctaBody: Posting is free. You are asked to sign in only at the final step.

employerFaq.heading: For employers — questions and answers
employerFaq.a1: Yes. Posting a vacancy and receiving applications costs nothing. The paid services are optional speed-ups only: TOP and bump.
employerFaq.a2: On the site (home, trade and region pages, the map and search), in the mobile app, and in our Telegram channel matching your trade and region. All of it happens automatically.
employerFaq.q3: Can I write the listing without an account?
employerFaq.a3: Yes — you can fill in the whole form; signing in is asked for only at the publish step, and nothing you typed is lost.
employerFaq.q4: Can I search for candidates myself?
employerFaq.a4: Once you publish, the platform assembles a list of matching candidates by title, experience and region. Each one can be invited in a single tap.
employerFaq.q5: How long does a listing stay up?
employerFaq.a5: Until the date you set; it closes automatically when that passes. You can close or edit it at any time.
